SMART CHROMA KEY — CLASSIC + AI

Before installation
Close OBS Studio. This installer supports normal 64-bit OBS Studio installations on Windows 10/11. OBS Studio 31 or later is required. Administrator permission installs the plugin for all users under ProgramData.

Add the filter
Open OBS, right-click your camera source and choose Filters. Under Effect Filters, press + and select Smart Chroma Key.

Choose a method
Classic: for a green or blue screen. Use Auto Detect and Analyze Screen Now, then adjust hair, edges and reflected screen color.
AI - Robust Video Matting (RVM): removes a person's background using the included model. Runs locally on the CPU; no extra download or account is required. First activation takes a few seconds.

AI performance
Start with 640 - balanced. Choose 320 for a slower computer, or 960/1280 for more detail. Higher resolution can lower the AI frame rate.
Choose Transparent for normal output. White, Black and Alpha matte are inspection views.

After installation
The finish page can open the full offline guide in English and Persian. You can also find it in the Start menu under Smart Chroma Key.
To remove the plugin, close OBS and uninstall Smart Chroma Key from Windows Settings > Apps. Your OBS scenes remain.
